content.label: I see nothing special about this app. It sounds just like every other lo-fi or easy listening or “focus music” on Spotify or YouTube easy to find.

This app has been a God send! At first I was hesitant to continue to pay for the app but with anything in life, it takes time to see the fruit of your labor. So if you are looking for an app that will help you focus, this is the app for you.
My entire life, I’ve seen to struggle with deep focus on specific tasks. This app has been a great tool in sharpening my focus and setting timelines for tasks!

This app definitely helps me maintain focus. 

It honestly might just be a placebo (I know there’s “science” behind it but idk), but regardless it works well for me. It always has; I used to look for those YouTube videos with various frequencies. 

The app itself is well designed and I use it frequently for both productivity and sleep. Try the free trial at the very least to see.

The two things that keep me at a 3-star review are:
Not being able to exclude all tracks with a specific meta data tag. I’ve discovered songs with “textural soundscape” tag are like nails on a chalkboard to me. There should be a way for me to exclude these tagged songs “categorically” instead of one by one. 
Requiring a $70 subscription. I understand there was research put in and effort to develop the app. It’s right at my tipping point for signing up in the first place. What’s kept me here are the nights I can’t sleep. I put on deep sleep and I’m out cold. 

I do find the music used in the app to be genuinely helpful. If you need help focusing on work, or have trouble sleeping, this has helped me with both of these.
I didn’t agree to a free trial of the app and deleted it before getting to explore options. Now I’m constantly hit with spam mail from Brain.com that won’t honor any unsubscribe requests.
Absolutely necessary for fundamental efficiency thank you

I honestly didn’t expect Brain.fm to make such a big difference for me. I usually study at night, and I would often find myself falling asleep while reading or studying. Since I started using Brain.fm, that hasn’t been an issue anymore. 

I don’t know exactly how the science behind it works, but somehow it really helps me stay focused and engage.  As a musician, I also really appreciate the music the music selection and how thoughtfully the sounds are designed. 

For me, it has become one of those tools I didn’t know I needed it until I try it. Definitely worth giving it a shot if you struggle with focus or staying awake while studying!
I use this every night to fall asleep and I’m during the day when I want to lock in.
The UI is absolutely gorgeous—huge shoutout to the devs, you really outdid yourselves! And the focus music/audio? I’m left completely speechless. It works so well.

When I want background music (with no lyrics) that will enhance the atmosphere of what I’m doing, from focused work to light tasks to a gathering of friends. This goes beyond mere binaural beats to actually provide real music developed by both scientists and artists
Been a great app helping motivate and ground me through nursing school. Thanks!

Epic app. Well done. Noticeably helps me focus, relax, chill, and fall asleep.

title.label: My brain needs Brain.fm daily to focus

content.label:
If you have a neurodivergent brain, this app is a lifesaver! 

For work, I listen to "Deep Focus" on my desktop computer every single day when I have to lock in and accomplish my tasks. In total silence, my brain goes off on tangents, but when I use brain.FM, it occupies the "wandering" or distracted part of my brain with non-lyric, interesting, non-repetitive looping jams so I can actually get things done.

For household tasks, or if I'm having trouble getting moving in the mornings, I use the "Motivation" music, and for whatever reason, it gets my toes tapping and helps me tidy, declutter, and finish chores with no struggling.

When I'm anxious or getting ready for a presentation or event, I listen to "Destress" while I'm preparing to calm my nerves.

At night, I listen to "Wind Down" or "Deep Sleep" to relax before bed.

Right now I'm on an 86-week streak of using this app in so many settings of my life, and I truly couldn't function without it. I recommend it to everyone I know who has ADHD or focus issues – it's exactly what I need to get things done!
I enjoyed the app and will be willing to work to pay a small premium for it, but they are completely out of their skull thinking that they can charge $100 for this!
I depend on it to get me to sleep quickly every evening. It's worth whatever I pay for it. I figure I am saving the money I spent on melatonin gummies.
I’ve dealt with playback issues like sudden stopping  or switching songs. The effect is great though and I hope an update takes care of it soon. 🙂
If u have trouble focusing or ADHD THIS HELPS SO MUCH!!!!
Didn’t expect it, but it’s genuinely helpful. I recommend it to all my neurodivergent or burnt out friends now :)

I’ve really only used the deep focus part of the app, but I’m excited to try the other modes too! Also, I reached out to the support team with some questions and they were prompt, friendly, and professional. I’m very happy with my experience so far.

closest thing to superpowers for attention deficit ppl

Brain.fm is a great equalizer with music that prevents my brain from wandering while also minimizing the attention seeking feeling that regular music has. 

It may not work for every person who tries it, but if you’re someone with similar experiences I’d recommend at least trying it.

title.label: I Really Wanted to Like It…

content.label: Interesting backend science, weak frontend empathy” is probably the best short description of Brain.fm. The neuroscience and audio engineering are genuinely compelling, and the music may help with focus during repetitive work. But the user experience feels underdeveloped. Features like “brightness,” “complexity,” and “neural effect” sound promising, yet the app offers little ability to search, organize, or meaningfully customize around them. Instead of encouraging exploration and experimentation, the experience feels limited, restrictive and overly dependent on trusting the algorithm. I like the concept… not the very simple and limited user experience.
This app is ridiculously priced for Ai generated music. Reduce prices by 75% or make it free.

After two years of Hatch brown noise that still left me waking nightly - sometimes for 2 hours - I tried this app based on a Claude AI recommendation about its brain frequency science. Three weeks in, I’m only waking maybe 2x a week and fall right back to sleep immediately. Falling asleep was never my problem; staying asleep was. This app has genuinely transformed my sleep quality and mood, and I use the high neural effect. It plays all night without cutting out, unlike another app I tried. Best sleep decision I’ve made since my blackout shades.
